methods.label: Evaluate the quotient and its floor
methods.explanation:
The divisor \(-\frac25\) is nonzero, so the supplied definition applies. First calculate the quotient inside the floor:
\[
\frac{3/8}{-2/5}
=\frac38\left(-\frac52\right)
=-\frac{15}{16}.
\]
Since \(-1<-\frac{15}{16}<0\), the greatest integer less than or equal to this quotient is \(-1\). Substituting that value gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
\operatorname{rem}\left(\frac38,-\frac25\right)
&=\frac38-\left(-\frac25\right)(-1)\\
&=\frac38-\frac25\\
&=\frac{15}{40}-\frac{16}{40}
=-\frac1{40}.
\end{aligned}
\]
The value is \(\boxed{-\frac1{40}}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
